description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.


The Cost Manager leads cost management for Lambda's portfolio of greenfield data center campuses and leased data center sites across the United States. The role reports to the Senior Director of Project Controls.

The Cost Manager owns how project cost is budgeted, committed, forecast, changed, and reported across the portfolio. The role sets the cost management procedures that every project follows, leads a team of cost analysts, and gives leadership an accurate and timely view of cost, forecast at completion, and contingency on every project.

The role brings recognized cost management practice, including AACE International Total Cost Management, earned value management, and owner-side commercial controls, to a fast-moving, capital-intensive AI infrastructure program. The successful candidate will make sure cost surprises are found early, change is controlled, and every dollar is coded the same way from budget through capitalization.

The Cost Manager partners closely with construction, engineering, procurement, finance, accounting, legal, and the other project controls disciplines. At Lambda, Project Controls is being built from first principles, so this role will build the cost management function to the level a multi-campus, multi-gigawatt capital program requires.


What You'll Do

Cost Management Framework

  • Establish and maintain cost management procedures, templates, and guidance for budgeting, commitments, forecasting, change control, and cost reporting, coordinated with the other project controls disciplines.

  • Align cost deliverables with the capital stage-gate process, so budgets and forecasts meet the maturity each gate requires.

  • Partner with cost engineering and Program Services on the code of accounts and WBS, so every project codes cost the same way and maps to capitalization categories.

  • Run periodic cost health reviews of each project, with findings tracked to closure.

Budgets & Forecasting

  • Own the control budget for each campus and lease site, from approved estimate through closeout.

  • Lead the monthly estimate-at-completion (EAC) forecast process with project managers, and challenge forecasts that are not supported by progress, commitments, or known risk.

  • Produce cash flow forecasts and spend curves for each project and the portfolio, in partnership with finance and treasury.

  • Apply earned value management to measure cost and schedule performance where it adds value.

  • Report contingency and management reserve usage against risk remaining, in partnership with Program Services.

Change Control & Commercial Management

  • Own the change control process, covering trends, potential change orders, change requests, and approved change orders, with clear approval thresholds.

  • Lead review and negotiation of contractor change orders, claims, and GMP adjustments with construction, procurement, and legal teams.

  • Review contractor pay applications, schedules of values, retainage, and allowances against contract terms.

  • Support contract strategy and the cost and payment terms in design-build, EPC, GMP, and trade contracts.

  • Lead cost audits of contractor billings and closeout reconciliations.

Reporting & Financial Integration

  • Deliver monthly cost reports for each project and the portfolio, including budget, commitments, actuals, EAC, variance, and contingency.

  • Provide cost data for portfolio dashboards, executive reporting, and board, lender, and partner reporting.

  • Work with accounting on month-end close, accruals, capitalization, and fixed-asset reporting.

  • Make sure cost data in the project controls and ERP systems is complete, accurate, and reconciled.

Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of cost analysts and cost engineers as the portfolio scales.

  • Provide functional leadership to cost staff and consultants on project teams.

  • Present cost status, forecast risks, and recommended actions clearly to senior leadership and investment decision-makers.

  • Partner with estimating, scheduling, and risk so cost, schedule, risk, and change information is integrated and reliable.

You

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.

  • Professional credentials such as AACE CCP or EVP, RICS chartered status, or PMP strongly preferred.

  • Typically 8+ years of experience in project cost management on large construction or capital projects, including experience leading a cost team.

  • Owner-side experience setting up cost management procedures and reporting across a multi-project capital program.

  • Expert in budgeting, commitment tracking, EAC forecasting, cash flow forecasting, and change control.

  • Strong commercial skills, including change order and claims negotiation and contractor billing review.

  • Strong understanding of work breakdown structures, codes of accounts, earned value management, and capital accounting requirements.

  • Experience with cost management platforms (for example Oracle Unifier, EcoSys, Procore, or equivalent) and integration with ERP systems.

  • Experience on greenfield construction and MEP-intensive facilities; hyperscale or mission-critical data center experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to turn cost data into clear decisions for executives.

Nice to Have

  • Hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical data center development.

  • Experience building a cost management function from the ground up.

  • Experience with multi-billion-dollar capital programs or portfolios.

  • Experience with stage-gate or Front-End Loading (FEL) capital governance.

  • Experience with EPC, design-build, GMP, or other major delivery models.

  • Experience with lender, joint venture, or partner cost reporting.

  • Experience with BI tools for cost reporting.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer
